# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/invalidate

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/invalidate

Invalidates the current session and clears the stored token.
Method Syntax

```python
client.invalidate(session)
```

###  Arguments[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/invalidate#arguments)  
| Argument  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| `session`  | An optional session id.  |  
###  Example usage[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/invalidate#example-usage)

```python
client.invalidate()
```
